nodes.label: Customize Tab
nodes.rationale: Changes apply live with a Revert/Keep bar; each extension feature is isolated so one that fails is switched off until next login while the rest keep working; nothing runs on the lock screen.

nodes.label: .dfprofile Profile Export
nodes.rationale: Imports validate every value: numbers clamped, unknown settings dropped, foreign picture paths flagged, dock and top bar never on the same edge.

nodes.label: Desktop Icons NG (DING)
nodes.rationale: DING is a separate GTK window that cannot sample the live wallpaper, so glass backplates are faked with tint, gradients, rim and shadow; rules are stored as a marked reversible import in the GTK 4 user stylesheet.

nodes.label: Top Bar
nodes.rationale: Hiding bars overlay content so revealing never resizes maximized windows; a hidden bar moves fully off its monitor; drags are ignored until dropped and bursts decided once to avoid flicker; reveal over fullscreen is off by default.

nodes.label: Profiles and Presets
nodes.rationale: A preset sets only look and feel and resets those settings to neutral first, so switching presets is deterministic; input, clock, lock screen, shortcuts and rules are never touched. Preview reverts after 20 seconds unless kept.

nodes.label: CLIVE Attachments
nodes.rationale: User-attached files bypass App Access switches because the user handed them over; limited to 8 files, 25 MB each, not from system folders.

nodes.label: Git Integration
nodes.rationale: Commands run as argument lists with hooks, fsmonitor, external diff and textconv disabled; read/commit run inside the Terminal sandbox, but pull/push need network and keys so run outside it.

nodes.label: App Access
nodes.rationale: Enforced where tools run, not in the interface: every action is checked against the switches at the moment it runs, so turning an app off stops the very next action even mid-task. The app switch overrides its capability switches. Defaults preserve what CLIVE could already do; apps installed later start off.

nodes.label: App Permissions (Ask Before)
nodes.rationale: High-risk actions (send email, delete, cancel events, push, install, admin) show exactly what will happen and wait for Confirm even under Auto-approve everything; administrator commands can never be set to not ask.

nodes.label: Side Door Closure
nodes.rationale: Switching off a service also blocks alternate routes to it (Thunderbird/Evolution/mail.google.com for Gmail, GNOME Calendar for Calendar, notes folder for file tools and Terminal) and redacts previously read results from model context.

nodes.label: Terminal Sandbox (bubblewrap)
nodes.rationale: Sandbox built from App Access switches: read-only system, no session bus/keyring/display sockets, no network unless allowed, credentials and switched-off app folders hidden. Run as administrator cannot be sandboxed, so it is handed to a visible Terminal window and CLIVE never sees the password or output.

nodes.label: Local Model Fallback
nodes.rationale: If the cloud fails during a task, CLIVE finishes it locally; model switches apply from the next request with no restart.

nodes.label: AT-SPI Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Screenshots are cropped to the app's own window so other windows never reach the model; authentication and lock-screen surfaces are never available.

nodes.label: Desktop Keyboard Grab
nodes.rationale: GNOME only delivers the keyboard to the desktop under an explicit grab, so the CLIVE card takes one when its text box is clicked and releases it on Esc or click elsewhere.

nodes.norm_label: launcher arrow motif (shortcut half of the app)
nodes.rationale: Comment: 'launcher arrow, for the shortcut half of the app'. Diagonal arrow into a corner bracket represents creating/launching desktop shortcuts.

nodes.label: Widget Cards Motif (text card, clock card, wide bar card)
nodes.norm_label: widget cards motif (text card, clock card, wide bar card)
nodes.rationale: Comment: 'two widget cards sitting on it' (the desktop surface). Cards show text lines, a clock face, and a wide strip, representing the desktop widget feature.

nodes.label: DesktopForge App Icon (org.jrf.DesktopForge.svg)
nodes.rationale: Blue (#62a0ea to #1c71d8) rounded-square app icon depicting a translucent desktop surface holding widget cards plus a launcher arrow; visually encodes the app's two halves: desktop widgets and desktop shortcuts. Icon name matches the app ID org.jrf.DesktopForge used for desktop-file packaging.

nodes.label: Folder Color Placeholders ($highlight, $color, $back, $edge)
nodes.rationale: string.Template-style substitution variables: $highlight->$color form the front-face vertical gradient, $back fills the rear panel, $edge fills the lip between back and face. Keeps one SVG shape as the single source for every folder color variant.

nodes.label: Folder Icon Template (folder.svg)
nodes.rationale: 128x128 folder icon (back panel with tab, edge strip, gradient front face) whose colors are $placeholders instead of literals, so the app can substitute per-folder colors at runtime to generate recolored folder icons.

nodes.label: Shell Smoke Test Wallpaper (wallpaper.svg)
nodes.rationale: 1200x850 synthetic wallpaper: horizontal blue (#1f439c) to purple (#782766) gradient, semi-transparent light-blue vertical stripes (40px every 80px), and a central orange (#ffb35c) circle. Deterministic, high-contrast fixture for the GNOME Shell smoke test, likely so wallpaper-dependent rendering (e.g. top bar/dock coloring or transparency) produces distinguishable, repeatable results.

nodes.label: Desktop Widgets
nodes.rationale: Cards are desktop-only and accept input only while uncovered, dropping behind any overlapping window; they stay inside the work area and snap to an 8-pixel grid.

nodes.label: Yahoo Chart Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Unofficial and may change, so it is isolated behind providers/base.py to be replaceable without changing widgets.

nodes.label: Data Providers
nodes.rationale: Providers do all external and system data access in the background service and write JSON state, so network work never blocks GNOME Shell.
